note: Every defect found in shipped work, what should have caught it, and what changed so it cannot happen again. audit-defects.mjs verifies the change is really in the file it claims, so a rule cannot be quietly removed and a fix cannot be claimed without being made. Open entries print on every build until they are closed.

Four videos sat on the live page as unlabelled rectangles while every Spotify block beside them carried a label, a title and a line saying why it was there. A server left running from another checkout answered first, its own server died unseen with EADDRINUSE, and the link and layout layers measured the other checkout's files. Found while fixing table-flush-against-next-paragraph: Playwright reported the repaired CSS as still broken because the pages it loaded came from the main working copy, not this worktree.

In CI nothing listened on 4173, so the vitals layer hung and the quality gate on PR #8 ran into its 20-minute timeout twice. Locally it passed, because a leftover server from the main checkout was on 4173 and got scanned instead.
